prompt: 我的知识库在 wiki/ 目录下，已经有一些关于 ML 架构的研究笔记了。帮我查一下：我目前的研究里，attention mechanism 和 mixture of experts 之间有什么联系？有没有已知的交叉工作？输出一份 markdown 报告到 outputs/reports/ 下，同时看看有没有需要补充的连接。

assertions.name: creates-report
assertions.text: A markdown report is generated under outputs/reports/

assertions.name: has-citations
assertions.text: Report cites specific wiki pages or concepts

assertions.name: creates-outputs-dir
assertions.text: Outputs directory structure follows skill convention

assertions.name: adds-connections
assertions.text: New connections or gaps are identified (wiki/connections/ or equivalent)

assertions.name: synthesized-answer
assertions.text: Report contains a synthesized answer, not just a list of sources
